name: DS3231 Real-Time Clock
description: The `ds3231` component provides support for the Maxim/Analog Devices DS3231 real-time clock (RTC). The DS3231 is a temperature-compensated RTC accurate to a few parts per million, and is found on inexpensive breakout boards such as the ZS-042.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the chip. Defaults to `0x68`.

config_entries.label: I2C ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the [I²C](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) bus when using multiple buses.

config_entries.label: Interrupt Pin
config_entries.description:
**Set at most one of:** `interrupt_pin`, `square_wave_frequency`.

The GPIO connected to the INT/SQW pin of the chip. The pin is open drain and active low, so it needs a pull-up (most breakout boards have one). With an interrupt pin the alarms are handled as soon as they fire instead of being polled. Can't be combined with `square_wave_frequency`.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.label: Square Wave Frequency
config_entries.description:
**Set at most one of:** `interrupt_pin`, `square_wave_frequency`.

Use the INT/SQW pin as a square-wave output instead of the alarm interrupt. One of `1Hz`, `1024Hz`, `4096Hz` or `8192Hz` (`1.024kHz` and the other kHz spellings work too). If not set, INT/SQW is the alarm interrupt output.

config_entries.label: Aging Offset
config_entries.description: Fine-tune the oscillator, from `-128` to `127`. Each step is about 0.1 ppm at 25 °C; positive values slow the clock down. If not set, the chip setting is left unchanged.

config_entries.label: Alarm Check Interval
config_entries.description: How often to poll the alarm flags. Without an `interrupt_pin` this is how alarms are detected; with one it is a fallback that picks up a missed interrupt. Only used when an `interrupt_pin`, an `on_alarm_*` trigger or an alarm binary sensor is configured. Defaults to `1s`.

config_entries.label: Auto Clear Alarms
config_entries.description: Clear an alarm flag on the chip as soon as the alarm has been handled, which also releases the INT/SQW line. When `false`, the flag stays set until it is cleared with the [`ds3231.clear_alarm`](https://esphome.io/components/ds3231/#ds3231-clear_alarm-action) action. Defaults to `true`.

config_entries.label: Battery Backed Square Wave
config_entries.description: Keep the square wave running while the chip runs from its backup battery. If not set, the chip setting is left unchanged.

config_entries.label: Output 32Khz
config_entries.description: Enable or disable the 32 kHz output pin. The chip enables it on power-up; if not set, the chip setting is left unchanged.
